thread:
Eli (Sales): Quick sync — Acme Health asked for concrete logging evidence for their vendor review: 13-month retention proof, sample admin-action exports (scrubbed), and recommended SIEM ingestion patterns for Splunk + Datadog. They also want CAIQ/SIG references around logging and key-management.
Priya (AE): They want something shareable before the exec demo next Tue. Can we provide a sanitized export + a short runbook showing how to ingest into their SIEM?
Rafael (SE): Yes. Hosted default audit retention = 90 days. For 13 months we offer two paths: hosted with retention add-on (storage charge + notarized bundle option) or Dedicated (configurable retention up to 24 months). Private is customer-controlled.
Rafael (SE): I prepared a redacted sample export (JSONL) for the team: https://redwood.example.com/poc/acme/redacted_admin_log_20260210.jsonl. Each line has ts, event, actor_id_hash, method, request_id, route, body_checksum, signature_id. Example: {"ts":"2026-02-10T10:22:00Z","event":"api.key.rotate","actor_id_hash":"sha256:...","method":"api","request_id":"r-001","body_checksum":"sha256:...","signature_id":"sig:hsm-20260210-01"}
Tracy (InfoSec): Important: we must show tamper-evidence. How are signatures produced and where are keys stored/rotated? Also they need chain-of-custody metadata (export user, export_ts, manifest checksum).
Rafael (SE): Good q — signatures generated by our Notary service (HSM-backed, FIPS 140-2 L3). Exports include manifest.json with file checksums and a Notary signature. Rotation policy: KMS keys rotate annually; HSM signing keys rotate per our key-management SOP. I'll attach the Notary README.
ops-bot: Notary job requested by rafael; queued as job:notary-20260211-09; est runtime 2h.
Priya (AE): Can Tracy pre-approve the sanitized sample to send to Acme? They won't accept PHI or direct emails.
Tracy (InfoSec): I reviewed the sample link — actor emails replaced with hashed IDs, no PHI fields present, IPs redacted. Approved for external sharing with NDA. :white_check_mark:
Eli (Sales): Pricing/contract Q: if we provide notarized exports + 13mo retention, does that require Dedicated only? Customer is cost sensitive.
Rafael (SE): Not necessarily. We can do notarized exports on Hosted as an enterprise add-on for attestations and extended storage for a monthly fee (GB-based). For sustained 13mo retention at scale we generally advise Dedicated for better unit economics and data isolation; will provide rough TCO.
Priya (AE): Plan: Rafael to deliver signed export + Splunk/Datadog ingest mini-runbook by EOD tomorrow. Tracy to sign off. I'll run through pricing scenarios and share a POC timeline with Acme.
Eli (Sales): Sounds good. Rafael — ping when job completes so I can attach artifacts to the sales packet.
ops-bot: notary-20260211-09 finished. Artifacts: https://redwood.example.com/poc/acme/notarized_export_bundle.tar.gz (manifest + signature).
Rafael (SE): Bundle produced and notarized. Splunk HEC ingest example included in the runbook.
Priya (AE): Sending to Acme now and scheduling the demo. Thanks team.
